mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in CPIAUCSL (consumer price index) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as accelerating inflation erodes real earnings and increases risk premiums.
failure_condition: When the month-over-month change in CPIAUCSL is positive, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the rank correlation between the signal and returns is less than 0.05 (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the FEDFUNDS rate exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% occurs in more than 60% of cases without negative 20-day returns, or the average 20-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% year-over-year, the combined signal of monetary tightening and high inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS>2.0% AND CPIAUCSL>2.5% YoY) occurs in more than 40% of cases without negative 20-day returns, or the rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and PAYEMS falls below 135000, it signals a weak labor market and high unemployment, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE>5.0% AND PAYEMS<135000) occurs in more than 40% of cases without negative 20-day returns, or the rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in HOUST (housing starts) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as rising housing activity signals a strengthening economy and improving corporate earnings.
failure_condition: When the month-over-month change in HOUST is positive, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases, or the rank correlation between the signal and returns is less than 0.05 (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls below 95, it signals a contraction in industrial production, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 occurs in more than 60% of cases without negative 5-day returns, or the average 5-day return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (RSAFS > 400000), a positive month-over-month change in HOUST predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong consumer demand supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In RSAFS > 400000, a positive month-over-month change in HOUST leads to negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or the rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS (federal funds rate) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as rate hikes increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: When the month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS is positive, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases, or the rank correlation between the signal and returns is less than 0.05 (p>0.05).
